market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. AI selloff likely to extend 1-2 weeks as safety narrative digests. Oil above $90-95 sustains inflation pressure. Fed Sept 16 meeting is binary catalyst: hawkish surprise could push 10Y to 5.2%+. S&P 500 may test support near 5,800-6,000. Expect 5-8% drawdown in tech-heavy indices.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. BofA's 7,400 S&P target implies AI capex cycle continues despite pause. Energy transition (LNG, critical minerals) and M&A consolidation support 6-12 month upside. Rate peak likely within 2 quarters. Key risk: if AI safety concerns trigger regulatory crackdown, tech multiples compress 20%+.
